description: This file defines a class 'LocalVectorStore' that manages a FAISS-based vector index, allowing adding, searching, saving, and loading vector embeddings along with associated metadata. It is used for efficient similarity search within a project that involves vector-based data retrieval.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class implementing a FAISS-based local vector store for adding, searching, saving, and loading vector embeddings with metadata.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with a specified dimension and creates a FAISS index.

methods.name: add_embeddings
methods.description: Adds a list of embeddings and their metadata to the index.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a similarity search for a query embedding, with optional filtering by chapter.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the index and metadata to disk at a specified path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the index and metadata from disk from a specified path.

methods.name: get_stats
methods.description: Returns statistics about the vector store, including total vectors, dimension, and total metadata entries.
